overview: Built an automated Shopify order processing system that handles order data, product costs, financial calculations, and reporting without manual spreadsheet work.
The workflow processes each order, calculates the relevant costs and profit, and automatically organizes the data into the correct Google Drive and Sheets structure.

list: Categorizes products based on product information
Retrieves variant and cost data from Shopify
Calculates fees, payouts, shipping, packaging, and net profit or loss
Identifies repeat customers and applies the required calculations
Determines the correct folder, spreadsheet, and sheet for each order
Creates missing folders, files, or sheets when required
Adds or updates order records in the appropriate sheet

result: A scalable order processing and financial tracking system that removes manual accounting work, keeps order data organized, and provides a consistent view of costs, payouts, and profitability as order volume grows.
